title: primal-dual ilqr for gpu-accelerated learning and control in legged robots
core_idea: Introduce an MPC implementation for legged robot locomotion that leverages GPU parallelization by using a parallel associative scan to solve the primal-dual KKT system, enabling both temporal and state-space parallelism and supporting large-scale parallel execution (implemented in JAX) to allow MPC and learning to run directly on GPUs.
tldr: A GPU-parallel primal-dual iLQR MPC formulation that enables temporal and state-space parallelism via a parallel associative scan, implemented in JAX to support large-scale MPC-in-the-loop learning for legged robots.
